tasks.intent: Classify and specify a new provider capability cache invalidation contract proof.
tasks.context_excerpt: The proof must isolate one atomic technical concept and must not call live providers.
tasks.reference: High score requires path src/draft/technical-proofs/provider-capability-cache-invalidation-contract, mocked providers, ADR, protobuf CUE Pact where boundaries exist, parse-don't-validate notes, isolated capability tests, and deterministic performance envelope or ADR non-applicability.

tasks.intent: Classify and specify a first-run workspace onboarding experience proof for platform admins.
tasks.context_excerpt: The proof is about user friction, not backend implementation.
tasks.reference: High score requires path src/draft/exp-proofs/workspace-onboarding-flow, ADR, audience model, friction inventory, measurable standards/specs, UX wireframes or image mockups, and mocked service boundaries.

tasks.intent: Classify and specify an isolated developer-experience epic proof that rolls up CLI login, token broker, and workspace onboarding proofs.
tasks.context_excerpt: The epic should reuse lower-layer artifacts and mock every service boundary outside the epic.
tasks.reference: High score requires path src/draft/epic-proofs/<slug>, reuse of technical and experience proof artifacts, compatibility ADRs, Gherkin/Cucumber features, mocked service boundaries, Pact fixture inventory, simulation docs, and a rollup ledger.

tasks.intent: Classify and specify a project MVP that integrates launch readiness epic proofs without inventing a fake product implementation.
tasks.context_excerpt: The first project layer should create standards and registry/templates only until a real MVP is scoped.
tasks.reference: High score requires src/draft/projects/<slug> only for a scoped MVP, project ADR, rollup ledger, epic proof integration evidence, and downward propagation of design changes with ADRs. Do not invent a fake MVP.
